name: Family Care Hospitals Limited
about: Family Care Hospitals Limited engages in the healthcare services business in India. The company offers general surgeries, gynecology, orthopedics, ENT, cardiology, urology, oncology, plastic surgery, and proctology services. It is also involved in the operation of an online pharmacy application, as well as offers solutions for various therapeutics areas, including cardiology, dermatology, diabetology, gastroenterology, general-laparoscopy-surgery, hematology, internal-medicine, nephrology, neuro-surgery, neurology, nutrition-dietician, ophthalmology, orthopaedics, paediatrics-neonatology, physiotherapy, plastic-cosmetic-surgery, psychiatry-clinical-psychology, pulmonology, radiology, spine-surgery, and thoracic-cardiac-surgeon. The company was formerly known as Scandent Imaging Limited and changed its name to Family Care Hospitals Limited in September 2022. Family Care Hospitals Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Thane, India.
